messages:
marta: Quick ping — can someone take a look at PR #2387? Updates JS REST client to add streaming toolcall helpers and tweaks header handling. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-sdk/pull/2387

james: taking a look now :eyes:

sam: FYI this touches the request header shim we discussed — maybe add a compat flag? Also add changelog entry.

marta: noted, added changelog and feature flag toggle in last commit. snippet: ```diff
index.js +4 -2
if (opts.compat) {
  // preserve old header behavior
}
```

arjun: CI failing on node 18 tests — looks like the streaming polyfill needs a small timeout tweak. I'll try a quick patch.

ci-bot: build #7682 failed on integration-tests (node18): stream-timeout.test.js:42 — timeout exceeded

james: unit tests pass for me locally, but agree integration flakes. can we move merge to next maintenance window if fixes are non-trivial?

laura: we're planning a small patch release tonight at 23:00 PT; if arjun can push fix before 21:30 PT we can include it. Otherwise we'll queue it for Tuesday morning.

marta: thanks all — arjun, ping me when you push. if not by 21:30 PT I'll mark as hold and add to backlog.

sam: also leaving a note to update the public SDK notes about breaking header behavior, add migration snippet for users using custom header shims. :memo:
